trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read (116w, prop) INCLUDING full recomputation of the table. Derived the identity: chi_lambda(sigma) = a q - b q^{-1} with a+b = f^lambda, so c_lambda = (a q^2 - b)/(q^2-1) is in Q(q^2) for EVERY lambda (the general claim is right), and self-conjugacy forces chi^lambda(odd) = 0 hence a = b = f^lambda/2 (integer iff f^lambda even). Independent invariant c_lambda = f^lambda/2 reproduces ALL FOUR rows: [2,1] f=2 -> 1; [3,1,1] f=6 -> 3; [3,2,1] f=16 -> 8; [4,1,1,1] f=20 -> 10. All four are genuinely self-conjugate. The three pair characters were checked at the q->1 limit against the S_5 character table: h^2 -> 0 = chi_{(3,1,1)}(3-cycle); h^2-2 -> -2 = chi on class (2,2,1); -h -> 0 = chi on the 4-cycle class - all three agree. Plancherel weight 16^2/720 = 35.6 pct matches the '36 pct' note.
